tasks.question: Audit SMTP outbound SSRF defenses, without sending traffic. Explain port rules, address classification including IPv4 embedded in IPv6, mixed DNS replies, DNS failure/empty answers, test-only/environment relaxations, and whether the actual TCP/TLS connection uses the vetted address while preserving TLS hostname identity. Start from packages/server/src/infrastructure/providers/smtp-outbound-policy.ts and smtp-client.ts. Inspect relevant tests and identify remaining evidence gaps, without claiming complete SSRF safety.

criteria.expected: ports 25/465/587/2525 by default, integer validation and explicit allowAnyPort override
denied metadata/link-local/multicast/reserved classes distinct from loopback/private; zone IDs invalid; IPv4 mapped/compatible IPv6 classified by embedded IPv4
all DNS answers vetted; any disallowed address rejects, not just first; hostname resolve once and IP literal bypasses DNS
DNS exception or empty addresses => SMTP_TARGET_REFUSED; selected first vetted address
allowLoopback relaxes loopback only; exact env SMTP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=true allows private, explicit allowPrivate overrides env; always-denied addresses still denied
TCP and TLS connect to vetted numeric address; TLS servername uses original hostname, STARTTLS wraps established socket; no second hostname lookup asserted from code
implementation and policy tests cited with mapped address/mixed DNS/override cases; no tests or network executed
no blanket safety claim; policy tests alone do not prove live DNS/TLS/SMTP or every network/config deployment boundary

tasks.question: Assess the tenant, authorization and concurrency safety of external-identity list/merge/split, including identity-code retirement and privacy impact. Start from packages/server/src/modules/external-identities/external-identity-admin.usecases.ts and prisma-external-identity-admin.repository.ts. Trace relevant HTTP caller identity, permission/workspace checks, transaction/locking/recheck paths and tests. Identify what source and tests do or do not establish about concurrency and privacy. Propose bounded missing regression cases where warranted; do not implement or claim an exploitable bug without a concrete supported path.

criteria.expected: HTTP user from scopedPrincipal; authorization uses current workspace, resolveAccessSubject and connectors.manage rather than role-name-only
list constrained to active/nonempty current workspace, up to1000 with truncated flag; DTO may expose real names to authorized administration
merge validates schema and different IDs, transaction authorizes, ordered workspace-scoped FOR UPDATE locks, workspace-scoped states ensure 404 foreign/missing and 409 retired
merge moves source accounts to target and retires source code; retired code stays reserved; id-only read/update safe only in context of preceding scoped checks, not universal RLS guarantee
split scopes composite account key, finds owner, locks then re-reads, refuses missing/one-account cases, creates fresh identity and moves only one account

analyze concurrency limits of split recheck if account owner changed while waiting: re-read does not automatically lock a different current identity; distinguish hypothesis from demonstrated exploit; propose interleaving regression
tests cover foreign workspace/unauthorized/permission override plus merge retirement/split; real-name privacy is separate non-admin read/pseudonymization requirement, not proved solely by admin DTO
cite implementation and tests, state no DB/tests executed and no exhaustive race/privacy guarantee; no unrelated auth/deployment changes proposed
